name: AIM PHOENIX Capital Compounding Policy
notes: Monthly allowance is a ceiling, not a guaranteed income or profit target.
Net realized profit must be after commissions, swaps or funding, and other costs.
Opening equity fixes eligible units for the month; mid-month growth does not increase that month's allowance.
No withdrawal is permitted unless post-withdrawal equity remains at or above the opening capital-unit floor.
PAPER_ONLY is the only enabled execution mode in this configuration.
